obligations.M: Mandatory: every record must have it.
obligations.MA: Mandatory if applicable: required when the stated condition holds.

elements.label: Title
elements.definition: Name of the resource.

elements.label: Creators
elements.definition: People or organizations primarily responsible for the resource, with ORCID iDs where available.

elements.label: Publisher
elements.definition: Entity that holds, archives, or makes the resource available (usually the repository or institution).

elements.label: Publication year
elements.definition: Year the resource was or will be made publicly available.

elements.label: Resource type
elements.definition: General type of the resource, using DataCite resourceTypeGeneral values.

elements.label: Identifier
elements.definition: Persistent identifier (DOI preferred) once one has been assigned.

elements.label: Description
elements.definition: Abstract or summary of the resource.

elements.label: Keywords
elements.definition: Free-text keywords.

elements.label: Language
elements.definition: Primary language of the resource (BCP 47 code, e.g. en).

elements.label: License
elements.definition: License for the resource, as an SPDX identifier where possible (e.g. CC-BY-4.0).

elements.label: Funding
elements.definition: Funders and award numbers.

elements.label: Data collection dates
elements.definition: Start and end of data collection (ISO 8601 dates).

elements.label: Geographic coverage
elements.definition: Countries (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) and, for the US, states (USPS codes) where data were collected.

elements.label: Related resources
elements.definition: Related publications, datasets, preregistrations, or instruments, with a DataCite relationType.

elements.label: Constructs measured
elements.condition: Mandatory when resource_type is Dataset or Instrument.
elements.definition: Constructs measured, from the STEMEd+ construct vocabulary (library/constructs.json), optionally with the instrument, version and subscale used.
elements.datacite: subjects (subjectScheme 'STEMEd+ Constructs', valueURI per construct); for datasets, relatedIdentifiers to the instrument's library record (URL, relationType IsCollectedBy) and its publication (DOI, relationType References); ERIC descriptors as additional subjects

elements.label: Discipline
elements.definition: STEM discipline(s) of the learning or research.

elements.label: Participant population
elements.definition: Who the participants are.

elements.label: Education level
elements.definition: Education level(s) of the participants.

elements.label: Undergraduate course level
elements.definition: Course level(s) for undergraduate studies.

elements.label: Population description
elements.definition: Narrative description of the participants and sampling, without identifying information.

elements.label: Sample size
elements.definition: Number of participants (or units) in the data.

elements.label: Institution type
elements.definition: Type(s) of institution or organization.

elements.label: Locale
elements.definition: Community type(s) where the study took place.

elements.label: Instructional modality
elements.definition: How instruction or participation was delivered.

elements.label: Learning environment
elements.definition: Instructional setting(s).

elements.label: Instructional approach
elements.definition: Instructional approach(es) used or studied.

elements.label: Study design
elements.condition: Mandatory when resource_type is Dataset or StudyRegistration.
elements.definition: Design(s) that produced the evidence.

elements.label: Measurement evidence
elements.definition: Kinds of reliability and validity evidence the resource provides.

elements.label: Data collection method
elements.definition: How data were collected.

elements.label: Human-subjects review
elements.definition: Ethics / IRB review status, as reported by the researcher.

elements.label: Participation consent
elements.definition: How participants agreed to take part.

elements.label: Consent for data sharing
elements.definition: What participants allow regarding sharing beyond the research team.

elements.label: Identifiability
elements.definition: Identifiability of the data.

elements.label: Sensitivity flags
elements.definition: Kinds of sensitive information in the underlying data.

elements.label: Access level
elements.definition: How the data can be accessed.

elements.label: Indigenous data
elements.definition: Whether the resource contains or derives from data about Indigenous Peoples, nations, communities, lands, territories, or knowledges.

elements.label: Indigenous data governance
elements.definition: How Indigenous authority to control the data is exercised (CARE: Authority to control).

elements.label: CARE statement
elements.definition: How the work provides collective benefit, respects authority to control, and meets responsibility and ethics obligations to the communities involved.

elements.label: Local Contexts project
elements.definition: URL of a Local Contexts Hub project holding Traditional Knowledge or Biocultural Labels or Notices for this resource.

elements.label: Local Contexts Labels and Notices
elements.definition: Names of Local Contexts Labels or Notices applied by the community (e.g. 'TK Attribution').

rules.message: Datasets and instruments must list at least one construct measured.
Datasets and study registrations must list at least one study design.
Instruments must list at least one kind of measurement evidence.
Open access requires data that are de-identified, anonymous, aggregate-only, synthetic, or not participant data.
Open access requires consent for broad sharing (or no human-subjects data).
Data cannot be open or registered-access while human-subjects review is 'not yet assessed' or 'pending'.
Indigenous data require a governance arrangement and a CARE statement.
Indigenous data may be open only under a community data governance agreement or tribal review approval.
Data from education records (FERPA): confirm the institution's FERPA review before any sharing.
Indigenous data status is unknown; assess it before sharing.
A specific community or a tribal college is involved; confirm whether the data are Indigenous data.
Direct identifiers are flagged; they must be removed before the data are shared.
